benchmark_scope: Known complete waveform, arrival, phase, channel and white Gaussian noise; NP presence Pd=Phi(sqrt(2rho)-isf(alpha)) with alpha=exp(-the same allocated score gate). Targets are strict99% and relaxed90%; separately named99% fields remain comparison diagnostics. This is an optimistic conditional presence benchmark at the chosen operational allocation, not a universal one-completion minimum, achieved correct-bit probability or an unknown-channel bound.

path_evolution.gaussian_target_correlation: exp(-0.5*(pi*B*tau)^2); B=2*sigma of each ray Gaussian Doppler PSD; existing ray-center separation is independent
path_evolution.gaussian_teacher: stationary proper-complex white Gaussian innovations convolved with a discrete L2-normalized Gaussian FIR; finite truncation and sampling approximate the target covariance; actual FIR shape is reported separately
path_evolution.outage_model: signal-only attenuation on [start,end), with cosine descent/ascent inside the interval; thermal noise and path/filter state continue
path_evolution.ray_model: fixed unit ray gains; existing equal-power two-ray delay and Doppler retained when selected
path_evolution.scope: declared physical-path stress, not field calibration; OU is point sampled and has an unbounded analog spectrum; the Gaussian FIR target also has unbounded spectral tails and its six-sigma-per-edge capture allowance is not strict support, so finite deterministic capture bounds are not a bandwidth guarantee and sampling-rate refinement is required

channel_model.sample_clock_reference: independent TX/RX endpoint errors; truth_clock_ppm reports their exact ratio
channel_model.selective_frequency_frame: fixed public channel frame; hidden oscillator truth is never used to recenter
channel_model.selective_law_note: dispersive-dft-v1 with auto scale is a spacing-scaled stress law; it does not represent the separately configured ray delay or Doppler
channel_model.selective_modulation_rate_source: effective spread Doppler; slow component runs at one tenth

spread_inputs.semantics: selected preset supplies nominal dimensions; explicit physical overrides replace their own nominal dimension before one margin multiplication; without preset, legacy channel values supply the base, and remain already effective when no override is supplied; receiver tap basis is independent

duration.scope: ten-Julian-year requested-active limit; complete private tiles, internal burst waits, pulse padding and channel/capture tails may extend actual elapsed duration

receiver_observation.coverage_policy_scope: C++ run receiver only; complete-calendar requirement and likelihood thresholds remain unchanged; external scorers declare their own coverage policy
receiver_observation.erasure_stage: after physical channel, noise and frontend; output I/Q and validity become zero while all physical state advances
receiver_observation.missed_dwell_calendar: floor((n/(Fs*RX_clock_scale) - capture_lead_seconds + retune_offset_seconds - calendar_origin_sample/Fs)/dwell_seconds); only nonnegative public receiver dwell indices are maskable

whole_bit_symbol_burst.scope: one-bit source renders this slot only; successor is public calendar metadata, not three internal wait tiles or multi-bit runtime support

confidence_scope: Exact binomial intervals are conditional per-cell summaries, not IID pooling across paired roots/cells or operational qualification.
energy_scope: Sampled export energy is pre-erasure. With inactive frontend and no erasures, rho=reported signal energy/noise variance. Missed-hop cells retain only pre-erasure energy and receive no post-erasure genie estimate.

later_reporting_only_variant.scope: Coordinator identifies one arithmetic-report field added after all campaigns finished; no arithmetic change or rescoring. Historical f912 source binding remains the experiment identity.

study_scope: Separate selected followup: independent32-signal A;16-signal half-duration B and higher-spread/sampling C paired on A subsets. Do not pool with initial four-signal cells. Historical source f912 remains bound; post-campaign local FFT metadata-only variant is a separately recorded hash.
verification_scope: All available results, records, bounded statuses/logs, score reports, manifest hashes, declared geometry and gate decisions independently checked. Raw basis/observation/validity bytes are absent from this compact archive: their recorded hashes are cross-bound, not independently re-read. Full group scores were omitted, so mixtures and residual UCBs cannot be recomputed from compact reports alone.
